items.title: Trigger quality evaluations when a support case is resolved
items.description: Quality evaluation plans can now run automatically when a support case is resolved. This helps organizations evaluate customer interactions at the right point in the service lifecycle, without relying only on scheduled or manual review processes. By triggering evaluations from the case resolution event, teams can reduce unnecessary re-evaluation, save review effort, and generate timely quality insights for resolved cases.

items.description: Start every collections day with one prioritized view of your receivables portfolio that explains each recommendation. The skill shows which customers need attention, why, and what to do next. It helps collectors, collection managers and accounts receivable (AR) leaders act consistently, close periods with fewer surprises, and step in before overdue balances become bad debt.

items.title: Exchange: Enable High Volume Email (HVE) for External Recipients
items.description: High Volume Email (HVE) External Sending extends HVE in Exchange Online, which today sends only to recipients inside your organization, so it can also deliver bulk email to external recipients such as customers and partners. It is designed for operational and transactional messages, like notifications, alerts, receipts and required communications, and not for marketing campaigns. Apps and devices send through SMTP using HVE account authentication. Admins turn the feature on for specific HVE acco

items.title: Dynamics 365 Human Resources: Ask HR - conversational HR self-service grounded in your own worker record
items.description:
Business value
Employees and managers routinely contact HR for answers their HR system already holds — how much leave they have, what their policy allows in their location, where a request has reached. The information exists, but it is spread across separate records, so a generic answer is often wrong for the individual asking. Workforce intelligence answers those questions from the person's own worker record, plan enrolment and jurisdiction, and lets them complete the related transaction in the

items.title: Dynamics 365 Human Resources: Streamline the employee offboarding experience
items.description:
Business value
When an employee leaves, HR, managers, IT, facilities and payroll all have work to do, but the termination hasn't been connected to the request that starts the exit or the work that follows. Manual coordination can leave access open, property unreturned and final pay incomplete. This feature connects the termination to a governed, visible exit journey, so HR runs consistent exits with less follow-up.

items.title: Work IQ: Listen
items.description: Enable agents to listen for supported Work IQ events and respond as relevant changes occur.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Configure a list of allowed external meeting notetaker bots for your Teams meetings
items.description: Admins will be able to configure more granular and advanced controls for managing external bots and their access to meetings hosted in their organization. Admins will be able to configure a list of external meeting bots which are allowed to join meetings hosted in their organization. Admins can also opt to block all other bots or let them be enforced into the currently available high friction lobby experience. The allowed bots will be treated like a regular external participant to the meeting an

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Voice phishing detection for external calls
items.description: Voice phishing detection helps protect Microsoft Teams users from potential scams during one-to-one calls with people outside their organization. Using AI, Teams analyzes conversations for signs of social engineering and alerts recipients when suspicious activity is detected, helping them recognize potential threats and decide how to proceed.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator follow-up mode
items.description: Chat naturally with Facilitator without tagging it each time.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Select Password from the context menu
items.description: Users can now manually access saved credentials when password suggestions don't appear automatically. When a user right-clicks a recognized username or password field, a new Select Password option appears in the context menu. This provides a reliable fallback path for sign-in scenarios where autofill suggestions are not surfaced, reducing the need for users to copy credentials manually. No configuration is required, and existing password management policies continue to apply.

items.title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Provide a Copilot starter prompt in Teams and LMS Assignments
items.description: Educators can provide a Copilot starter prompt from Student AI Guidelines in Teams and LMS Assignments. Students open Copilot with the educator's prompt ready in their chat, helping them begin with instructions tailored to the assignment.

items.title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Assign Study and Learn in Teams and LMS Assignments
items.description: Educators can assign Study and Learn from Student AI Guidelines in Teams and LMS Assignments. Students open guided learning support grounded in the assignment's title, instructions, and supported files and resources, helping them work through concepts and practice their understanding.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live support for webinars and structured meetings on Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: Participants joining webinars and structured meetings from Teams Rooms on Android can view and interact with PowerPoint Live presentations. This provides greater flexibility and accessibility while keeping room participants aligned with the active presentation.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Apply default SharePoint library labels to data at rest
items.description: Enables auto‑labeling of existing SharePoint files to match the default sensitivity label configured on their document library. This helps organizations close labeling gaps for data at rest and ensure consistent, secure‑by‑default protection across SharePoint libraries—without relying on manual user labeling.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars on Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: When a Teams Rooms on Android device acts as an organizer, co-organizer, or presenter in a structured meeting or webinar, you have access to the private chat for event management known as the Event Group. You can also switch to a separate chat with attendees, enabling smooth event experiences for all. Available in Teams Rooms Pro-licensed rooms.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Invite attendees to register
items.description: For an event that needs registration, send email invites to the selected people and groups who will be invited to register to the event

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Pop out sign language interpreter meeting video for continuous visibility
items.description: Keep communication more accessible throughout your meeting. You can now pop out a sign language interpreter into a separate, resizable window that stays visible across monitors and apps. Designed to support Deaf and Hard of Hearing users, the sign language interpreter's popout video will persist while viewers are multitasking, sharing content, or changing meeting layouts.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Autolaunch opt-in experience for managed devices
items.description: Microsoft Edge will introduce an opt-in experience that allows users on managed devices to choose whether Edge launches automatically when Windows starts. Administrators can also manage this behavior through the LaunchEdgeOnWindowsStartupEnabled policy with opt-in, opt-out, and user-choice configurations.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.158 - Inline Switching for Workspaces
items.description: Workspaces Inline Switching manages multiple Workspaces in a single window. Selecting a Workspace swaps in its tabs, theme, and context, with an easy return to the default space.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.158 - Automatically unsubscribe users from notifications sent by scam and malicious sites
items.description: Microsoft Edge now helps further protect users from malicious web notifications. When a notification leads users to a site that Microsoft Defender SmartScreen blocks as a scam, phishing, or malware page, Edge automatically stops that source from sending users further notifications and lets users know. Users can review and restore any of these sites anytime under edge://settings/privacy/sitePermissions/allPermissions/notifications.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.158 - Import Google account data anytime from Settings
items.description: Microsoft Edge now lets users import their Google account data - including passwords, bookmarks, history, and autofill data - directly from Edge Settings, at any time after setup. Previously, users had no way to import this data from a Google account outside the first-run experience. With this update, the import flow is unified into a single, streamlined entry point in Settings that combines import from Google Chrome import and Google account.

items.title:
Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person
meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: In addition to capturing real-time notes and meeting outcomes during scheduled or hybrid meetings, the Facilitator agent assists you with notes, decisions and actions for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Android. Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console. Meeting notes appear on the front of room display or touch board, are available via meeting recap when shared, and deleted if no one selected. Rest assured no data remains in the room. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Call quality feedback surveys for Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: Users can now rate the quality of their calls and meetings and provide additional feedback on calling, video, and screen-sharing experiences to help organizations ensure consistent, high-quality experiences.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Pick up where you left off in channels on desktop
items.description: Stay on top of channel conversations by picking up right where you left off. Choose to open Teams channels at your last read message instead of the most recent message, making it easier to catch up on conversations and follow discussions without losing your place.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: PPAC Reporting API
items.description:
Power Platform reporting API for Copilot credits provides customers with access to Copilot Credit usage from Copilot Studio through the Power Platform API, extending the existing reports available in the Power Platform Admin Center.
Details of the API methods are available in the Microsoft Power Platform API reference - Power Platform API | Microsoft Learn, providing insights into usage by resource, environment, user, and feature. New reports and capabilities will continue to be released.
These

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Triage Agent - Sensitive Data Remediation through Microsoft Teams
items.description: The Data Security Triage Agent in Data Loss Prevention now offers a new sensitive data remediation function, which empowers organizations to proactively identify and remediate sensitive information—such as Social Security Numbers, passwords, and credit card data—across thousands of files stored in SharePoint or OneDrive locations, dramatically increasing the percentage of remediated files with sensitive information, resulting in reduced compliance risk. Seamlessly integrated with Microsoft Purvi

items.title: Power Apps: Use the modernized Personal settings experience
items.description:
The Personal settings experience in model-driven apps has been modernized with clearer organization, updated navigation, and a more consistent design.
Users can select a button to return to the classic Personal settings experience if needed.

items.description:
Row summaries are expanding to supported US Government clouds, giving users in regulated environments access to AI-generated insights that help them understand model-driven app records at a glance. This release brings the row summary experience available to commercial customers to supported government environments while meeting their applicable compliance and data-boundary requirements.
Admins and makers enable and configure row summaries for users in their model-driven apps.

items.title: Power Apps: Expand model access and Maker Studio availability for generative pages via GitHub
items.description:
Connect your GitHub account to access additional model options for the built-in gen page coding agent directly in the generative page designer in Maker Studio. Makers can use the agent to create and refine generative pages without leaving the Power Apps authoring experience.
This integration also brings Maker Studio generative page authoring to regions without dedicated Power Apps GPU capacity.
Model availability through GitHub may evolve over time, and requests made through this connection cons

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Smarter and faster update application
items.description: Microsoft Edge can now apply pending updates when your browser is idle. We've updated the Relaunch Notification policy to allow you to manage idle restarts for your organization.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Simplified Energy Saver
items.description: Energy saver, formerly known as efficiency mode, will have new defaults and different setting options. Edge will now support and recommend users to use the BatterySaverModeAvailability policy to manage the energy saver feature. The energy saver feature has been simplified to become enabled under two conditions: on low battery or when unplugged. The default will be for energy saver to be enabled on low battery. Energy saver will now have one mode. Users set to Balanced savings will be mapped to h

items.title: Planner: Expiration of plans from meetings due to inactivity
items.description: Planner plans created from Teams meetings (via Meeting Notes or Loop) often remain unused long after the meeting ends. These inactive plans accumulate and clutter over time. This feature automatically expires and deletes meeting-created plans that have had no task activity for 180 days. Only the Planner plan is removed whereas the tasks in Loop and meeting notes stay intact.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Report suspicious guest invitations
items.description: Microsoft Teams will enable users to report suspicious guest invitations directly from Teams. When users receive an unexpected or potentially malicious guest invitation, they can report it to their IT admin for review, helping identify and mitigate phishing and other abuse through guest invitations.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enable agents for existing applications in your organization
items.description: For third-party applications already being used in your organization, admins can now discover and enable the corresponding Teams agents from within the Teams Admin Center. Admins receive recommendations for high-value agents and gain visibility into any required configuration changes during the enablement workflow. These agents increase employee productivity by bringing their everyday applications into the flow of work in Teams. This helps organizations get more value from their existing softwar

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Self-serve sync connectors
items.description: Self-serve sync connectors enable users to securely connect their own external data sources, such as Jira and Confluence Cloud, to Microsoft 365 Copilot. Using their own credentials and permissions, users can synchronize content they already have access to, making it discoverable in Copilot Chat and Microsoft Search. Administrators maintain oversight through tenant-level controls, including staged rollout, visibility management, and connector disablement.

items.title: SharePoint: Cross-post SharePoint News to Engage
items.description: This feature allows SharePoint News authors to distribute posts to an Engage community or storyline while preserving full fidelity rendering and a unified conversation experience. SharePoint News post will appear consistently in Engage across feeds, digests, Outlook, Teams, desktop, web and mobile apps. When distributed, the SharePoint News comments module is replaced with the richer Engage conversation module, ensuring a single, shared discussion thread across surfaces.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Recently used emojis sync across devices
items.description: Recently used emojis and reactions sync across Teams on desktop and mobile, making it easier to express yourself wherever you work.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Improved content freshness using Copilot connectors with webhooks-led notifications
items.description: Copilot connectors will offer improved content freshness with more frequent sync of updates using webhook event notifications. The following connectors are in scope - Azure DevOps, Jira cloud, Confluence cloud, Trello, Asana, Bitbucket, GitHub and Gitlab.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Improved content freshness using Copilot connectors with webhooks-led notifications
items.description: Copilot connectors will offer improved content freshness with more frequent sync of updates using webhook event notifications. The following connectors are in scope - Azure DevOps, Jira cloud, Confluence cloud, Trello, Asana, Bitbucket, GitHub and Gitlab.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Run Python code as a step in workflows
items.description:
The new Code node lets makers run Python as a step in a workflow for logic that expressions and connectors can't handle.

Data transforms, calculations, regex, and advanced parsing.
File conversion and parsing (for example PDF → text, CSV, XML).
Generate the code from natural language with AI, or write and edit it by hand.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Generate documents from the Agent node in workflows
items.description:
The Agent node can now return files that the agent generates, such as PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and CSV, as workflow outputs.

Works with both inline agents and existing (published) agents.
Generated files appear as an ordered files output (name, content type, content) that's available to downstream steps.
Pass files to connectors to email, save to SharePoint/OneDrive, or attach to records.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Share workflows with co-owners for collaborative editing
items.description:
Makers can share a workflow with other users as co-owners so they can view, edit, and manage it.

Share from the workflows page or the designer.
Review the connections the workflow uses and their permissions before sharing.
See who the workflow is shared with when reopening Share.
Co-owners can edit and run the workflow.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Service principal owner for workflows
items.description: Workflows can now be owned under a service principal (a Microsoft Entra app registration) instead of a named user account.
